metadata.chapter: Chapter 26 - CIVIL EMERGENCY, EMERGENCY, OR LOCAL DISASTER

content.title: Chapter 26 - CIVIL EMERGENCY, EMERGENCY, OR LOCAL DISASTER — Sec. 26-44. - Access to TABOR funds.
content.summary:
In the event of a declared civil emergency, emergency, or disaster, the city manager
               shall have access to the city emergency funds mandated by the Taxpayer's Bill of Rights
               (TABOR) as set forth in Article X, Section 20, Subsection (5) entitled Emergency Reserves,
      …

faqs.a:
In the event of a declared civil emergency, emergency, or disaster, the city manager
               shall have access to the city emergency funds mandated by the Taxpayer's Bill of Rights
               (TABOR) as set forth in Article X, Section 20, Subsection (5) entitled Emergency Reserves,
               of the Colorado Constitution. Funds utilized pursuant to this chapter shall be replenished
               no later than the conclusion of the following fiscal year.
(
Ord. No. 4827
, § 2, 12-5-2022)
